toolbar.name: Parking
toolbar.description: Parking areas for idle vehicles in four size classes.
legacy.name: Vehicle parking (legacy, 4 slots)
legacy.description: Existing four-slot parking area retained for compatibility with older save games.
inspector.filter.title: Allowed vehicle types
inspector.filter.tooltip: Select any number of vehicle types. An empty filter allows all supported ground vehicles and excludes detected aircraft; select aircraft explicitly to opt in.
inspector.filter.clear.tooltip: Reset the vehicle filter to the safe ground-vehicle default. This also removes saved entries for uninstalled vehicle mods.
inspector.rotation.tooltip: Align parked vehicles with the arrow. Off by default; exact centering stays enabled.
inspector.rotation.reverse.tooltip: Align parked vehicles opposite to the arrow (180°). Off by default; exact centering stays enabled.
inspector.assignment.title: Assign parking area to building
inspector.assignment.tooltip: Only idle vehicles assigned to this building use this parking area. Real work jobs always take priority.

style.transparent.category.name: Transparent
style.paved.category.name: Paved
style.transparent.category.description: Keeps the terrain visible, allows surfaces to be placed underneath, and reduces the maintenance multiplier by an additional 5 percentage points.
style.paved.category.description: Includes a non-replaceable driving surface, sets the maintenance multiplier to 50%, and uses 10% fewer concrete slabs than manual paving.
style.transparent.name: transparent
style.paved.name: paved
style.transparent.maintenance.descriptio: The underlying terrain remains visible and can still be surfaced. The maintenance multiplier for parked vehicles is reduced by an additional 5 percentage points, including on player-built or modded surfaces.
style.paved.maintenance.description: Includes a non-replaceable driving surface that sets parked vehicles' maintenance multiplier to 50%. Construction uses 10% fewer concrete slabs than manually paving the same area.
